title: AgenticReviewFinding
description: Normalized finding produced by any scanner (Semgrep, jscpd, Lizard, coverage, Gitleaks, etc.) or by a normalizer script. This is the Phase 0 contract for Phase 1 metrics jobs.

engine.description: Scanner or normalizer that produced the finding.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier from the engine (e.g. semgrep rule id, jscpd clone id).

category.description: High-level finding class for gates and PR UX.

path.description: Repo-relative file path when applicable; null for repo-wide metrics.

remediation.description: One-line guidance on how to fix.

in_pr_diff.description: True if the finding touches files/lines changed in the PR. Gates should prefer in_pr_diff=true.

fingerprint.description: Optional stable hash for dedupe across runs.

raw.description: Optional engine-specific payload for debugging; not used by the gate.
